title: Skilled Care Frequency and Physician Recertification Figures — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage requires daily skilled services and a certified need for them. The figures are common to all six tiers.

| Figure | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Days per week skilled nursing must be needed and provided | 7 |
| Days per week skilled rehabilitation must be provided when rehabilitation is the only skilled service | 5 |
| Covered-day number by which the first physician recertification must be signed | Day 14 |
| Maximum calendar days between later physician recertifications | 30 |
| Days after a lapsed certification may be billed to the resident | No — they are provider liable |
| Medically necessary therapy may continue under Medicare Part B after Part A SNF days end | Yes |

### Judgement points

- Daily skilled services are met by skilled nursing on 7 days a week, or by skilled rehabilitation on 5 days a week where rehabilitation is the only skilled service.
- The first recertification is due no later than covered day 14; each later one follows within 30 days of the previous.
- Days that fall after a lapsed certification are borne by the center and never billed to the resident.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a resident receiving only therapy on 5 days each week meets the daily-skilled requirement; a resident receiving only therapy on 4 days does not.
